definition.en: The attachment conventionally described as the more fixed end of a muscle; which end moves can change when a foot is planted.
definition.zh: 习惯上称为较固定端的肌肉附着；脚踩地时，实际活动的一端可能改变。

definition.en: The attachment conventionally described as the end drawn towards the origin; muscle pull acts on both attachments.
definition.zh: 习惯上称为被拉向起点的一端；肌肉拉力实际作用于两端附着。

definition.en: Sheets and bands of connective tissue around muscles; the iliotibial tract is a thickened band, not a contracting muscle.
definition.zh: 包绕肌肉的结缔组织薄膜或长带；髂胫束是增厚的筋膜，不是主动收缩的肌肉。

definition.en: The four-headed muscle at the front of the thigh that extends the knee; rectus femoris also crosses the hip.
definition.zh: 大腿前方伸膝的四头肌，股直肌还跨过髋关节。

definition.en: The posterior-thigh group: semitendinosus, semimembranosus and biceps femoris. The short biceps head crosses only the knee.
definition.zh: 大腿后方肌群，包括半腱肌、半膜肌和股二头肌；股二头肌短头只跨膝。

definition.en: A muscle crossing two joints, so its length depends on the positions of both.
definition.zh: 跨过两个关节的肌肉，长度同时受两个关节位置影响。

definition.en: The strong band from the patella to the tibial tuberosity carrying the pull of the quadriceps.
definition.zh: 从髌骨到胫骨粗隆的坚韧长带，传递股四头肌拉力。

definition.en: The spreading attachment of sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus tendons on the upper inner tibia.
definition.zh: 缝匠肌、股薄肌和半腱肌的腱在胫骨上端内侧展开形成的附着。

definition.en: Pointing the foot down at the ankle, as when raising the heel while the forefoot stays planted.
definition.zh: 踝部让脚向下指的动作，例如前脚掌踩地时抬起脚跟。

definition.en: Drawing the top of the foot towards the shin, as when lifting the forefoot with the heel down.
definition.zh: 足背靠近小腿前方的动作，例如脚跟留地时抬起前脚掌。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which an active muscle lengthens under tension.
definition.zh: 动作中肌肉保持张力，同时被拉长的阶段。

definition.en: Strong connective tissue transmitting a muscle’s pull to its attachment, commonly on bone.
definition.zh: 把肌肉拉力传到附着处的坚韧结缔组织，通常连接骨骼。

definition.en: Bending and straightening mainly at the hips while the spine stays steady, as in a Romanian deadlift.
definition.zh: 主要从髋关节弯曲、伸展，同时稳住脊柱的动作模式，例如罗马尼亚硬拉。
